name: Bunkers
source:
You have a task in guiding a young girl, Sigel, through dangerous post-apocalyptic bunkers. Along the way you'll have to use your wits and luck to protect Sigel and keep her safe. But as you journey deeper into the bunkers, you discover that the greatest danger may be the secrets that they hold. Can you survive the bunkers and protect Sigel?

[from [url=https://triopse.itch.io/bunkers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的任务是引导年轻女孩西格尔穿过危险的后世界末日掩体。一路上你必须运用你的智慧和运气来保护西格尔并保证她的安全。但当你深入地堡时，你会发现最大的危险可能是它们所隐藏的秘密。你能在掩体中生存下来并保护西格尔吗？

[来自[url=https://triopse.itch.io/bunkers]itch.io[/url]]
